Title: About 1 in 3 Adults Has Gastritis - 3 Habits That Make It Worse

Description:
Gastritis affects roughly a third of adults in industrialized countries. Beyond H. pylori infection, three daily habits make the inflammation worse: alcohol, which irritates the stomach lining directly; chronic stress, which cuts blood flow to the lining while raising acid output; and smoking, which cuts mucus and blood flow to the lining while raising acid output. Cutting back on alcohol, building in stress breaks, and quitting smoking all help protect your stomach lining.
